ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Keyed click
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
A Pickle step that clicks a button by the translation key its label comes from, so a scenario runs in any language. Development only: never published, no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See KeyedClick/README.md at the repository root.
It is the same step as the one proposed to Pickle itself as a pull request; when that lands this mod's step can go.
